text:
Maya Chen: Quick debrief — EU-west promo run hit near-OOM saturation for some Dedicated pools, want short notes + actions
Ben Ortiz: Timeline: spike at 13:02 UTC, queued tokens up ~3x, latency SLO breaches on /v1/generate for 7m
Linh Tran: Observed memory climb tied to KV-cache growth after we routed a burst of long-context requests (>=8k tokens)
Raj Patel: node logs show OOM kills then pod restarts; autoscaler didn't scale because it missed nodes with tag 'redwood-dedicated-euw' due to format change in provider response
Carlos Mendez: Small network flaps between euw1-a/b delayed cache priming and amplified per-request memory pressure
ops-bot: Alert: gpu-util>92% for 4m; queued-requests>500; kv_cache_growth_rate>2.8x/min
Ben Ortiz: quick log excerpt:
```text
[13:02:11] kv_cache_size=12.3G -> 38.9G
[13:02:14] cgroup memory limit exceeded, pid=4231
[13:02:15] pod restart: inference-runtime-7c9d
```
Maya Chen: Hypothesis (combined): 1) routing weight shifted +30% long-context to EUW1 for promo, 2) autoscaler tag parsing bug prevented timely scale-up, 3) transient network blips made cache misses pile up and increased memory footprint
Linh Tran: Also saw spot evictions on 3 nodes ~3m after spike — removed buffer capacity we normally use for bursts
Raj Patel: Immediate mitigations we applied: drained low-priority queues, rolled back routing weight by 20%, bumped reserved headroom to 25% for EUW1 (temp)
Carlos Mendez: Cost impact: bumping headroom +25% raises reserved GPU-hours ~+480 GPU-hrs/week, rough cost delta +$35k/mo. Need finance signoff for sustained change
Maya Chen: Long-term action items: fix autoscaler tag parser, add kv_cache growth-rate alert and dashboard, implement circuit-breaker for long-context routing per-region, add test for spot eviction scenarios in CI
Ben Ortiz: Suggest a new SLO: max kv_cache per node <= 24GB and alert at 18GB, plus limit long-context routed QPS per-region
Raj Patel: I'll open infra PRs: autoscaler fix + integration test harness for provider tag variations (owner: Raj, ETA: EOD+3)
Linh Tran: I'll add dashboard panels comparing kv_cache growth vs long-context request rate and publish link (owner: Linh, ETA: EOD+2)
Carlos Mendez: I'll model cost vs reliability tradeoff and propose a phased reserved capacity plan for peak seasons (owner: Carlos, sync w/finance by EOD+5)
ops-bot: Tickets created: INFRA-3219 (autoscaler tag fix) assigned Raj, INFRA-3220 (kv_cache alert & dash) assigned Linh, INFRA-3221 (routing circuit-breaker) assigned Maya
deploy-bot: Rolled back routing weights at 13:27 UTC and applied temporary headroom bump
Maya Chen: Owners + deadlines repeated: Raj (autoscaler) EOD+3, Linh (dash) EOD+2, Carlos (cost) EOD+5, Maya (routing policy) EOD+4. We'll follow up in INFRA channel once PRs land :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: +1
Carlos Mendez: +1, starting cost calc now
Raj Patel: on it
Linh Tran: will post dashboard link when ready
Maya Chen: Closing thread here; moving details into tickets for tracking and retro notes later
